note: COUNTS ONLY. Real (vulnerable function, fixed function) pairs where the function survives the fix, mined at zero model cost from reviewed GitHub advisories for the six compiled families, added as pointer-pair corpus benchmarks/pairs/advisory-fixes-2 (98 pairs, source `advisory-fixes-2` in learn/sources.toml), labelled, given static feature records and built into the memory store; their excerpts embedded. No chat-model call. Candidate, path, function and repository names stay in the catalog; the two pairs the reserved-population test flagged are withheld (never printed: found by bisection with the test's output discarded).

method.enumeration: gh api /advisories?type=reviewed&ecosystem=<eco>&cwes=<family CWEs>&published=>2025-06-01, per ecosystem (pip, npm, maven, composer, go, rubygems) x family; newest first
method.automated_screen: single family by CWE; a linked fix commit (at most 3, one repository); repository not named anywhere under benchmarks/ (populations v1/v2, every pair corpus; excluded v3 file names never opened), no WordPress plugin, one pair per repository; SPDX licence permissive; one-parent commit with <= 4 non-test source files and <= 120 changed source lines; the function holding most changed CODE lines (comments and blanks excluded) inside its own matcher span, declared exactly once on both sides, body changed, >= 25% of the file's changed code lines (second pass; the first pass counted lines by nearest declaration above)
method.file_reads: the two versions of each changed source file through the contents API (metadata + two raw files per file; no clone, no scanner, engine, plane task or model on any of these repositories)
method.manual_review: every automated candidate's function diff was read (agent, no model call) and kept only when the named function itself holds the fix
method.reserved_population_guard: tests/test_independent_population.py::test_no_reserved_repository_is_referenced_by_the_development_tree, run with its output discarded; bisection over catalog subsets, 23 runs
method.quotas: 20 per family on the second pass (14 on the first); advisories past a met quota were not examined
method.mechanism: family default (injection/output_encoding/deserialization source_reaches_sink, path path_join_user_input, access_control missing_auth_guard, untrusted_destination validation_strength for CWE-601 else source_reaches_sink); provenance = agent

kept.known_limit: excerpts inherit the label builder's matcher: some spans run past the function's end into the next declaration; the label is path::function and the changed lines were checked inside the span

features.command: benchmarks/learn/build_features.py --labels <the 392 new rows> --units <units.json of `ousast plane harvest --catalog benchmarks/pairs/advisory-fixes-2/catalog.toml` (manifests written, no Run started)> --kinds pairs
features.note: quick rules and deterministic roles ran on each side; engine, verify, agree and model sinks never ran for these pairs (missing/none: null features, never zeros)

memory_build.command: ousast learn memory build --labels <labels> --units <merged units.json> --profile static --root . (exit 2: adjudications 9 of 43 anonymous functions, unchanged since 2026-10-01; rows kept)

positives_only_groups.how: the 2026-10-02 gap record's count: static example rows of the store, per family, repository groups with a positive and no negative
positives_only_groups.before_note: the store before this harvest held 937 examples (the 10-02 gap record counted 904 and 98; the 10-02 rebuild added one population-v2 positive without a negative)
positives_only_groups.why_unchanged: the 99 are data gaps of other corpora (94 vibe-py pairs whose fixed side lost the function, 3 dev-php, 2 population-v2); a new repository group arrives with both labels, so it adds paired groups and leaves those counts as they were

embeddings.command: ousast learn memory embed --budget-usd 0.20 (dry run first: 66,005 estimated tokens, $0.0013)
embeddings.note: embedded = the new pairs' excerpts plus the excerpts the 10-02 rebuild left without a vector; OpenRouter, the embedding model .env names
